themes.title: Bass onset scoop
themes.summary: Coach asked the bass to land directly on pitch without scooping, then assigned a speak-on-pitch exercise.

themes.title: Lead diphthong in time
themes.summary: Coach instructed the lead to delay the second half of the diphthong.

themes.title: Tenor release alignment
themes.summary: Tenor must release exactly with the lead.

themes.title: Baritone soften the third
themes.summary: Possibly coach-originated suggestion to reduce baritone's third.

themes.title: Humming exercise
themes.summary: Quartet should rehearse the phrase on a hum before adding words.

themes.title: Pickup breath coordination
themes.summary: Everyone breathe together before the pickup.

themes.title: Tag tempo control
themes.summary: Do not speed through the tag.

themes.title: Starting pitch ownership
themes.summary: Lead takes responsibility for giving the starting pitch.
